sourceDivergences.finding: Existing contracts/open-finance/loans-2.7.0.yaml is Certifying; Current is 2.6.0.
sourceDivergences.decision: Preserve 2.7.0 unchanged; import 2.6.0 into active expansion catalogue.

sourceDivergences.finding: Some Current buttons have null versionDocURL in official SPA data.
sourceDivergences.decision: Use API family portal page plus exact original official repository artefact, recording null explicitly.

sourceDivergences.finding: Consents 3.4.0 appears in both Implementing and Certifying.
sourceDivergences.decision: Keep both source statuses; neither joins active scope.

sourceDivergences.finding: Treasury 1.0.2 Retired appears twice in source table.
sourceDivergences.decision: Retain original source; deduplicate exclusions by family/status/version.

sourceDivergences.finding: DA insurance, pension and capitalization are explicitly listed as Fase 4A Dados Abertos in the Open Finance portal.
sourceDivergences.decision: Include these OF open-data families. No Open Insurance private contracts inferred or imported.

sourceDivergences.finding: Full versions such as loans 2.6.0/2.7.0 share /v2.
sourceDivergences.decision: Bind full version to release; honour x-v where specified; do not resolve version from major route alone.

limitations: Inventory proves original specification preservation and operation enumeration only. Runtime, mocks, releases, HTTP coverage, PCM eligibility and MQD support are separate evidence stages and remain not-assessed here.
